name: Coinbase AgentKit
description: Gives AI agents onchain wallets and the ability to transact, with action providers for payments, swaps, and smart contract calls across major agent frameworks.

skills.name: Wallet Provisioning
skills.description: Creates and manages a server-side wallet for an agent so it holds funds and signs its own transactions.

skills.name: Onchain Actions
skills.description: Executes transfers, token swaps, and smart contract calls through composable action providers.

skills.name: Framework Adapters
skills.description: Plugs the same onchain toolset into LangChain, the OpenAI Agents SDK, the Vercel AI SDK, and Eliza.
